detailed_findings.finding: The core order-theoretic argument is complete: arbitrary x ∈ S, contradiction from x > 1/4 using the given upper-bound hypothesis, then conclude x ≤ 1/4.
The equivalence back to the original formulation with existence of a witness function g for each admissible r is correctly unpacked from the definition of S.

reason: The proof correctly applies the definition of maximal element: from 1/4 ∈ S and the hypothesis that every r > 1/4 is not in S, it shows any x ∈ S cannot satisfy x > 1/4, hence x ≤ 1/4. Together with 1/4 ∈ S this proves 1/4 is the largest element of S. The final unpacking of the definition of S is semantically faithful to the theorem statement.
